variants.prompt: In a candlelit chamber, this stunning Italian beauty sits cross-legged on a velvet divan, her emerald gaze burning with intense, dominant heat. Full lips are pressed into a firm, commanding line as she surveys the space with a bold, unyielding air. A sheer, beaded bodysuit leaves little to the imagination, emphasizing her every curve and muscle as the soft glow of candlelight dances across porcelain skin.
